# DeepScreen

> Stock screening and fundamental research for supported listings on NSE, BSE, NYSE, Nasdaq and LSE in India, the United States and the United Kingdom.

Canonical website: https://deepscreen.online/
Publisher: DeepScreen
Contact: deepscreen.online@outlook.com

## Product and markets
- [Global stock screener](https://deepscreen.online/): Exchange directories and company search.
- [NSE directory](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NSE): Supported Indian NSE listings.
- [BSE directory](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/BSE): Supported Indian BSE listings.
- [NYSE directory](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NYSE): Supported US NYSE listings.
- [Nasdaq directory](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/NASDAQ): Supported US Nasdaq listings.
- [LSE directory](https://deepscreen.online/exchange/LSE): Supported UK LSE listings.
- [Pricing](https://deepscreen.online/pricing): Current plan terms; consult this page rather than assuming prices.

## Research and evidence
- [Questions and answers](https://deepscreen.online/answers): What the platform does, coverage, data limits and common research questions.
- [Research checklist](https://deepscreen.online/research-checklist): Eight-step workflow for verifying filings, cash flow, debt and valuation assumptions.
- [Methodology](https://deepscreen.online/methodology): 13-factor scoring approach and limitations.
- [Data sources and corrections](https://deepscreen.online/data-sources): Provider inputs, illustrative models, primary disclosures and correction contact.
- [Ratio glossary](https://deepscreen.online/ratios): Definitions, formulas and cautions.
- [Learning guides](https://deepscreen.online/learn): Educational stock research guides.
- [Press resources](https://deepscreen.online/press): Factual product overview and media enquiries.

## Public machine-readable resources
- [Developer documentation](https://deepscreen.online/developers): Read-only educational reference API; no authentication.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://deepscreen.online/openapi.json): Actual supported GET endpoints and response schemas.
- [Exchange metadata](https://deepscreen.online/api/v1/exchanges): Names, codes, countries, currencies and directory URLs.
- [Metric definitions](https://deepscreen.online/api/v1/metrics): Educational definitions, formulas and cautions; no company financials.
- [Answers JSON](https://deepscreen.online/api/v1/answers): Questions, answers and references.
- [Answers SSML](https://deepscreen.online/answers.ssml): The same answers for compatible speech synthesis tools.
- [Sitemap](https://deepscreen.online/sitemap.xml): Canonical public page discovery.

## Interpretation and limits
DeepScreen is a research tool, not personalized investment advice or a guarantee of returns.
Directory coverage does not mean every company has complete financial data.
Provider availability, reporting dates and retrieval times differ. Do not describe all data as real time.
Company tables withhold unavailable inputs and complete scores when required data is missing.
Some supplementary panels use illustrative model data. Those values must not be cited as reported company facts.
Indian filing ratios may come through Screener.in; other supported exchange inputs may come through Yahoo Finance. This does not imply affiliation or endorsement.
Verify material values in the company's primary disclosures, including period, currency, units and accounting basis.
The public API supplies reference content only: no live quotes, trading, account data or private portfolios.
When referencing a definition or answer, link to its public source page and retain its limitations.
